spans.s: पदकम् [padakam], A step, position, office; see पद.
कः An ornament of the neck.
One conversant with the पदपाठ q. v.
A निष्क or weight of gold.
पदनीय [padanīya], a. To be investigated or known (ज्ञातव्य); तदेतत्पदनीयमस्य सर्वस्य यदयमात्मानेन ह्येतत्सर्वं वेद Bṛi.
A foot (said to be m. also in this sense); पदेन on foot; शिखरिषु पदं न्यस्य

'set foot on (follow) a wrong road'; 3.5;12.52; पदं हि सर्वत्र गुणैर्निधीयते 3.62 'good qualities set foot everywhere' i. e. command notice or make themselves felt; जनपदे न गदः पदमादधौ 9.4. 'no disease stepped into the country'; यदवधि न पदं दधाति चित्ते
; पदं कृ (a) to set foot in, on or over (lit.); शान्ते करिष्यसि पदं पुनराश्रमे$स्मिन् Ś.4.2. (b) to enter upon or into, take possession of, occupy (fig.); कृतं वपुषि नवयौवनेन पदम्
; कृतं हि मे कुतूहलेन प्रश्नाशया हृदि पदम् 133; so
'in defiance of us'; (lit. planting his foot on our neck); मूर्ध्नि पदं कृ 'to mount on the head of', 'to humble'; पदं मूर्ध्नि समाधत्ते केसरी मत्तदन्तिनः
'good forms attract attention (command respect); जने सखी पदं कारिता Ś.4; 'made to have dealings with (to confide in)'; धर्मेण शर्वे पार्वतीं प्रति पदं कारिते
A step, pace, stride; तन्वी स्थिता कतिचिदेव पदानि गत्वा Ś.2.13; पदे पदे 'at every step'; अक्षमालामदत्त्वा पदात् पदमपि न गन्तव्यम् or चलितव्यम् 'do not move even a step' &c.; पितुः पदं मध्यममुत्पतन्ती

'the middle pace or stride of Viṣṇu.'; i. e. the sky (for mythologically speaking, the earth, sky, and lower world are considered as the three paces of Viṣṇu in his fifth or dwarf incarnation वामनावतार); so अथात्मनः शब्दगुणं गुणज्ञः पदं विमानेन विगाहमानः
A foot-step, footprint, foot-mark; पदपङ्क्तिः Ś.3.7; or पदावली foot-prints; पदमनुविधेयं च महताम्
'the foot-steps of the great must be followed'; पदैगृर्ह्यते चौरः
A trace, mark, impression, vestige; रतिवलयपदाङ्के चापमासज्य कण्ठे
A place, position, station; अधो$धः पदम्
; आत्मा परिश्रमस्य पदमुपनीतः Ś.1, 'brought to the point of or exposed to trouble'; तदलब्धपदं हृदि शोकघने
, 'found no place in (left no impression on) the heart'; अपदे शङ्कितो$स्मि
, 'my doubts were out of place', i. e. groundless; कृशकुटुम्बेषु लोभः पदमधत्त
Dignity, rank, office, station or position; भगवत्या प्रश्निकपदमध्यासितव्यम्
; यान्त्येवं गृहिणीपदं युवतयः Ś.4.18, 'attain to the rank or position, &c.; स्थिता गृहिणीपदे 4.19; so सचिव˚, राज˚ &c.
Cause, subject, occasion, thing, matter, business, affair; व्यवहारपदं हि तत्
; 'occasion or matter of dispute, title of law, judicial proceeding';
; सतां हि सन्देहपदेषु वस्तुषु Ś.1.22; वाञ्छितफलप्राप्तेः पदम्
Abode, object, receptacle; पदं दृशः स्याः कथमीश मादृशाम् Śi.1.37; 15.22; अगरीयान्न पदं नृपश्रियः
; अविवेकः परमापदां पदम् 2.3; के वा न स्युः परिभवपदं निष्फलारम्भयत्नाः
A quarter or line of a stanza, verse; विरचितपदम् (गेयम्)
A complete or inflected word; सुप्तिडन्तं पदम्
A name for the base of nouns before all consonantal case-terminations except nom. singular.
Detachment of the Vedic words from one another, separation of a Vedic text into its several constituent words; वेदैः साङ्गपदक्रमोपनिषदैर्गायन्ति यं सामगाः
A pretext; अनिभृतपदपातमापपात प्रियमिति कोपपदेन कापि सख्या Śi.7.14.
A part, portion or division (as of a sentence); as त्रिपदा गायत्री.
Protection, preservation; ते विंशतिपदे यत्ताः संप्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे
A square or house on a chessboard; अष्टापदपदालेख्यैः Rām.
(In Arith.) Any one in a set of numbers the sum of which is required.
A coin; माता पुत्रः पिता भ्राता भार्या मित्रजनस्तथा । अष्टापदपदस्थाने दक्षमुद्रेव लक्ष्यते ॥
A way, road; षट्पदं नवसंख्यानं निवेशं चक्रिरे द्विजाः
. -दः A ray of light.-Comp. -अङ्कः, चिह्नम् a foot-print. -अङ्गुष्ठः the great toe, thumb (of the foot). -अध्ययनम् study of the Vedas according to the पदपाठ q. v. -अनुग a.
following closely, being at the heels of (gen.).
suitable, agreeable to. (-गः) a follower, companion; एतान्निहत्य समरे ये चृ तस्य पदानुगाः । तांश्च सर्वान् विनिर्जित्य सहितान् सनराधिपान् ॥
an army. -अनुशासनम् the science of words, grammar. -अनुषङ्गः anything added to a pada.
अन्तः the end of a line of a stanza.

the end of a word. -अन्तरम् another step, the interval of one step; पदान्तरे स्थित्वा Ś.1; अ˚ closely, without a pause. -अन्त्य a. final.-अब्जम्, -अम्भोजम्, -अरविन्दम्, -कमलम्, -पङ्कजम्, -पद्मम् a lotus-like foot. -अभिलाषिन् a. wishing for an office.
अर्थः the meaning of a word.
a head or topic (of which the Naiyāyikas enumerate 16 subheads).

anything which can be named (अभिधेय), a category or predicament; the number of such categories, according to the Vaiśeṣikas, is seven; according to the Sāṅkhyas, twentyfive (or twenty-seven according to the followers of Patañjali), and two according to the Vedāntins.

the sense of another word which is not expressed but has to be supplied. ˚अनुसमयः preforming one detail with reference to all things or persons concerned; then doing the second, then the third and so on (see अनुसमय). Hence पदार्थानुसमयन्याय means: A rule of interpretation according to which, when several details are to be performed with reference to several things or persons, they should be done each to each at a time. -आघातः 'a stroke with the foot', a kick.-आजिः a foot-soldier.
आदिः the beginning of the line of a stanza.

the beginning or first letter of a word. ˚विद् m. a bad student (knowing only the beginnings of stanzas). -आयता a shoe. -आवली a series of words, a continued arrangement of words or lines; (काव्यस्य) शरीरं तावदिष्टार्थव्यवच्छिन्नापदावली
.-आसनम् a foot-stool. -आहत a. kicked. -कमलम् lotus-like foot. -कारः, -कृत् m. the author of the Padapāṭha.
क्रमः walking, a pace; न चित्रमुच्चैः श्रवसः पदक्रमम् (प्रशशंस) Śi.1.52.

a particular method of reciting the Veda; cf. क्रम. -गः a foot-soldier.-गतिः f. gait, manner of going. -गोत्रम् a family supposed to preside over a particular class of words.-छेदः, -विच्छेदः, -विग्रहः separation of words, resolution of a sentence into its constituent parts. -च्युत a. dismissed from office, deposed. -जातम् class or group of words. -दार्ढ्यम् fixedness or security of text.
position of the feet in a particular attitude.
writing down verses or quarters of verses; अप्रगल्भाः पदन्यासे जननीरागहेतवः । सन्त्येके बहुलालापाः कवयो बालका इव ॥ Trivikramabhaṭṭa. -पङ्क्तिः f.
a line of foot-steps; द्वारे$स्य पाण्डुसिकते पदपङ्क्तिर्दृश्यते$भिनवा Ś.3.7;
a line or arrangement of words, a series of words; कृतपदपङ्क्तिरथर्वणेव वेदः

a kind of metre. -पाठः an arrangement of the Vedic text in which each word is written and pronounced in its original form and independently of phonetic changes (opp. संहितापाठ).-पातः, विक्षेपः a step, pace (of a horse also). -बन्धः a foot-step, step. -भञ्जनम् analysis of words, etymology.
भञ्जिका a commentary which separates the words and analyses the compounds of a passage.
a calendar. -भ्रंशः dismissal from office. -माला a magical formula. -योपनम् a fetter for the feet (Ved.).

literary composition. -वायः Ved. a leader. -विष्टम्भः a step, footstep. -वृत्तिः f. the hiatus between two words.-वेदिन् a linguist, philologist. -व्याख्यानम् interpretation of words. -शास्त्रम् the science of separately written words.
संघातः (टः) connecting the words which are separated in the संहिता.
a writer, an annotator.-संधिः m. the euphonic combination of words. -स्थ a.
being in a position of authority or high rank. -स्थानम् a foot-print.
पदविः [padaviḥ] वी [vī], वी f. [पद्-अवि वा ङीप] A way, road, path, course (fig. also); पवनपदवी
'follow in the footsteps of the good'; Ś.4. 14;
, 'he attained his majority' (grew up to man's estate).
Position, station, rank, dignity, office, post; एतत् स्तोत्रं प्रपठता विचार्य गुरवाक्यतः । प्राप्यते ब्रह्मपदवी सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः ॥ Tattvamasi
पदाजिः [padājiḥ] पदातः [padātḥ] पदातिः [padātiḥ], पदातः पदातिः [पद्भ्यामतति, अत्-अच्]
.-Comp. -अध्यक्षः the commander-in-chief of the infantry. -लव (पदातिलव) a. most humble.
Being or going on foot. -m. A foot-soldier.
पदारः [padārḥ], 1 The dust of the feet.
An animal moving with its feet.
Containing only one division. -कः A footman.-कम् The point of the foot.
Amounting to a quarter or fourth; पादिकं शतम्, 25 per cent.
Lasting for a quarter of the time; Ms 3.1.
पदीकृ [padīkṛ], To raise to the square root.
. Ā. (पद्यते, पन्न; caus. पादयति-ते; desid, पित्सते)
To attain, obtain, gain; ज्योतिषामाधिपत्यं च प्रभावं चाप्यपद्यत Mb.
To observe, practise; स्वधर्मं पद्यमानास्ते Mb.
Ved. To fall down with fatigue.
P. (पदति) To stand fast or fixed.
पद् [pad], m. [पद्-क्विप्] (This word has no forms for the first five inflections; it is optionally substituted for पद after acc. dual)
A quarter, a fourth part (as of a stanza). -Comp. -काषिन् a.
going on foot, pedestrian. (-m.) a footman; पत्काषिणस्तीर्थजला$र्थमाशु
a Śūdra; cf. पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत. -नद्धा, -नध्री a shoe, boot.-निष्कः one quarter of a Niṣka. -रथः (पद्रथः) a footsoldier, footman; त्वं पद्रथानां किल यूथपाधिपः

;6.55;11.87; कविप्रथमपद्धतिम् 15.33; 'the first way shown to poets'.
a surname, title or epithet, a word denoting caste or profession in compounds which are used as proper names; e. g. गुप्त, दास, दत्त &c.
N. of a class of writings. -हिमम् (पद्धिमम्) coldness of the feet.
पद्ग [padga] पद्रथ [padratha], पद्रथ &c. See under पद्.
द्मम् A lotus (m. also in this sense); Nelumbium Speciosum (variety red); पद्मपत्रस्थितं तोयं धत्ते मुक्ताफलश्रियम्.
The form or figure of a lotus.
The coloured marks on the trunk and face of an elephant; कालः किरातः स्फुटपद्मकस्य वधं व्यधा- द्यस्य दिनद्विपस्य
An army arrayed in the form of a lotus; पद्मेन चैव व्यूहेन निविशेत सदा स्वयम्
A particular high number (one thousand billions).
N. given by the Tāntrikas to the six divisions of the upper part of the body calledChakras.
A mark or mole on the human body.
N. of a particular part of a column.-द्मः A kind of temple.

One of the nine treasures of Kubera; see नवनिधि.
A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment.
A particular posture of the body in religious meditation.
One of the eight treasures connected with the magical art called पद्मिनी.

a pond or pool or water in general.
an assemblage of lotuses; पद्माकरं दिनकरो विकचीकरोति
. -आलयः an epithet of Brahman, the creator.

a particular posture in religious meditation; ऊरुमूले वाम- पादं पुनस्तु दक्षिणं पदम् । वामोरौ स्थापयित्वा तु पद्मासनमिति स्मृतम् ॥; ध्यायेदाजानुबाहुं धृतशरधनुषं बद्धपद्मासनस्थम् Rāmaraṣā 1.
(नः) an epithet of Brahman, the creator.
of the sun. -आह्वम् cloves.-उद्भवः an epithet of Brahman. -कर, -हस्त a. holding a lotus.
N. of the sun. (-रा, -स्ता) N. of Lakṣmī.

the central part of an army arrayed in the form of a lotus.-कलिका a lotus-bud, an unblown lotus. -काष्ठम् a fragrant wood used in medicine. -केशरः, -रम् the filament of a lotus.

a position of the fingers resembling the calyx of a lotus. -खण्डम्, -षण्डम् a multitude of lotuses. -गन्ध, -गन्धिa. lotus-scented, or as fragrant as or smelling like a lotus. (-न्धम्, -गन्धि n.) = पद्मकाष्ठ q. v.
the inside or middle of a lotus; पद्मगर्भादिवोद्धृतम्

cloves.-जः, -जातः, -भवः, -भूः, -योनिः, -संभवः epithets of Brahman, the lotus-born god. -तन्तुः the fibrous stalk of a lotus. -नाभः, -भिः an epithet of Viṣṇu; शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशम्.

a magical formula spoken over weapons. -नालम् a lotus-stalk. -निधिः a treasure of the value of a Padma.

of Viṣṇu. -पुष्पः the Karṇikāra plant. -प्रिया the goddess Manasā, the wife of sage Jaratkāru. -बन्धः a kind of artificial composition in which the words are arranged in the form of a lotus-flower; see K.

a bee. -बीजम् the seed of a lotus. -भासः an epithet of Śiva. -मालिनी the goddess of wealth. -मुद्रा (-द्रिका) a particular pose according to Tantraśāstra; हस्तौ तु संमुखौ कृत्वा तदधः प्रोथिताङ्गुली । तलान्तर्मिलिताङ्गुष्ठौ कृत्वैषा पद्ममुद्रिका ॥ Tantrasāra.-रागः, -गम् a ruby;

; आकरे पद्मरागाणां जन्म काचमणेः कुतः ॥ H. -रूपा an epithet of the goddess of wealth. -रेखा a figure on the palm of the hand (of the form of a lotus-flower) which indicates the acquisition of great wealth.

or of Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning.

of Durgā. -हस्तः a particular measure of length. -हासः an epithet of Viṣṇu.
